pilot_launch_status: NOT_LAUNCHED — design only, do not activate

api_architecture.pattern: STATIC_ASYNC — all methods are static and return Task
api_architecture.output_pattern: IOutputHandler callback — caller implements IOutputHandler to receive output stream
api_architecture.concrete_output_handler: FolderOutputHandler — implements IOutputHandler, saves streams to folder
api_architecture.key_difference_from_pdf_words: No file-path output parameters. Output is routed through IOutputHandler callback. Cannot simply pass output file path.

available_methods: static Convert(Stream input, string nameWithExtension, IOutputHandler handler, string outputType) -> Task
static ConvertEmlOrMsg(Stream input, string nameWithExtension, IOutputHandler handler, string outputType) -> Task
static ConvertToEml(Stream input, string nameWithExtension, IOutputHandler handler) -> Task
static ConvertToHtml(Stream input, string nameWithExtension, IOutputHandler handler) -> Task
static ConvertToMht(Stream input, string nameWithExtension, IOutputHandler handler) -> Task
static ConvertToMhtml(Stream input, string nameWithExtension, IOutputHandler handler) -> Task
static ConvertToMsg(Stream input, string nameWithExtension, IOutputHandler handler) -> Task

recommended_primary_scenario.rationale: HTML output is text-readable for validation. ConvertToHtml is the most demonstrable: turns EML into readable HTML. No special MIME dependencies.

fixture_strategy.approach: Create EML content programmatically as a string, convert to MemoryStream. No Aspose.Email API needed for fixture creation — raw RFC 2822 formatted string is sufficient.
fixture_creation_code: // Create a minimal RFC 2822 EML as a string

var emlContent = "From: sender@example.com
To: recipient@example.com
Subject: Test Email

Hello from LowCode Email Converter.";
fixture_strategy.output_validation: Check outputDir contains at least 1 .html file; file size > 0; file content contains 'Hello from LowCode'
fixture_strategy.async_requirement: All Converter methods return Task — example must use async/await or .GetAwaiter().GetResult(). Simplest: wrap in Task.Run(() => ...).Wait() or make Main async.
fixture_strategy.async_main_pattern: static async Task Main(string[] args) { ... await Converter.ConvertToHtml(...); }
fixture_strategy.licensing_note: Unlicensed mode may add evaluation watermark to HTML output. Validation: Contains() not Equals() for content checks.
fixture_strategy.dependency_gap_risk: MEDIUM — email.yml already has 7 deps resolved in discovery. Standard Aspose.Email deps. No known reflection blockers.

required: REQUIRED: await Converter.ConvertToHtml(inputStream, nameWithExtension, handler) — use async/await; method returns Task
REQUIRED: IOutputHandler handler — use FolderOutputHandler to capture output; no direct file path parameter
REQUIRED: FolderOutputHandler — concrete IOutputHandler implementation; saves output to a folder
forbidden: FORBIDDEN: MailMessage.Save() as the primary operation — use LowCode Converter async method
FORBIDDEN: passing file path directly as output parameter — Converter uses IOutputHandler callback, not string output path
